final: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - a.rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a WHERE r.rate > a.rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
